doc.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023

title: Opening and introduction
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Tom Porrello, described as the quintessential lead trumpet player.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Tommy Porrello with me this afternoon. And we’re many miles apart but I’m looking forward to speaking with you. A mutual friend described you as “the quintessential lead trumpet player.”
